reason: Color tokens are declared once as light-dark(light, dark) in tokens/schemes.css. getPropertyValue() returns the unresolved light-dark(...) text, alone or inside a composite value such as a box-shadow, where 2.1.1 returned the per-scheme literal. 85 tokens carry it: the 57 written with light-dark(), the tokens defined from them with var() (for example --femto-primary-hover-underline, --femto-card-box-shadow and the two --femto-group-box-shadow-focus-with-* tokens in tokens/base.css), and the generic --femto-background-color, --femto-color, --femto-border-color, --femto-box-shadow and --femto-underline that later modules set from them on elements. What the tokens resolve to is compared separately (kind token) and matches, except tokens-group-island-focus-ring.
notes: Seeded from femto's tests/divergences/tokens.json at 7bcd5758 (tokens-light-dark-raw-text; femto category new-token, module tokens/schemes). Site: narrowed, as femto narrowed its own list to the names its runs reported, to the 81 of femto's 85 names whose raw text differs on the site (p2-registry-base-1, every route, all four legs, Chrome and Firefox): --femto-border-color, --femto-code-color, --femto-form-element-focus-color and --femto-underline show no token-raw record here. With all 85 the entry named 85 of the 163 token names on the 404 page (52%), past the in-page 50% limit.

reason: 2.1.1 builds the two group focus-ring tokens on :root, :host from var(--femto-primary-focus) and var(--femto-form-element-border-color), so the value is fixed in the root's scheme and a nested data-theme island, or an element carrying data-theme itself, inherits the page's ring color. With light-dark() the token keeps the pair and resolves per element, so inside an island whose scheme differs from the page the ring takes the island's color. Only the box-shadow probe resolves these tokens.
notes: Seeded from femto's tests/divergences/tokens.json at 7bcd5758 (tokens-group-island-focus-ring; femto category natural-fix, module tokens/base). Site: the anchors are the dark code islands (div.code and footer.code with data-theme=dark) on the docs pages and the thead with its own data-theme on /docs/table.

reason: --femto-primary-inverse-filter replaces a compile-time @if in _styles.scss, which picked the loading-spinner filter on filled buttons by comparing the theme's primary-inverse to white: brightness(0) invert(1) for the 14 white-inverse themes, brightness(0) invert(0) for amber, grey, lime, pumpkin, sand and yellow. tokens/base.css declares it on :root, :host, where 2.1.1's literal applied (every root and shadow host, whatever its scheme), and theme files override it there; the computed filter is unchanged.
notes: Seeded from femto's tests/divergences/tokens.json at 7bcd5758 (tokens-new-names; femto category new-token, module tokens/base). Site: declared on every page.

reason: Same cause as femto-tokens-light-dark-raw-text, on a token of the site's own: site/assets/css/common.css sets --femto-card-component-outline-color: var(--femto-card-background-color) in the dark scheme (as the oracle's commons did), and femto declares --femto-card-background-color once as light-dark(light, dark), so getPropertyValue() returns the substituted light-dark() pair where 2.1.1's per-scheme literal gave #181c25. The resolved color is the same.
notes: A site consequence of femto's tokens-light-dark-raw-text (femto tests/divergences/tokens.json at 7bcd5758, femto category new-token), kept as its own entry so the main entry stays within the in-page share. Seen on every route in the dark and theme-dark legs (p2-registry-base-1).
